title: Track Metadata
description: Track entry shape, derived from the FrankX data/music-asset-registry.json catalog format. Use for any AI-generated or conventional track registry.

sunoId.description: Generation-platform id (Suno UUID), if AI-generated there

audio.description: Audio-measured features captured at intake by FrankX analyze-audio.py (D6 — breaks the canon-fit circularity: a scorer that only reads declared/prompt metadata can never disagree with the prompt that generated it). `measured` overrides declared metadata (genre/bpm/key claims) for canon-tagging purposes; `mismatchFlags` records where they disagree so intake can react (e.g. below-threshold match -> no Guardian proposed, never nearest-by-default).

measured.description: Raw measured values as emitted by analyze-audio.py (librosa for bpm/pitch/key, ffmpeg ebur128 for LUFS).

lufsIntegrated.description: Integrated loudness in LUFS (ffmpeg ebur128), independent of any declared mastering target.

analyzedWith.description: Tool/library provenance for this measurement pass, e.g. ['librosa', 'ffmpeg-ebur128'].

mismatchFlags.description: Field names where `measured` disagrees with declared metadata (e.g. 'bpm', 'key', 'genre'). A non-empty list below the canon-fit match threshold means the tagger proposes no Guardian, per D6.

vibe_state.description: Optional: the vibe-state this track targets (name from a vibe-state library)

usage.description: Where the track is used (content, film, sync placements)

license.description: License classification (see FrankX music-licensing agent taxonomy)
